strings.tab.title: Gameplay
strings.page.intro: Change supported player values while the game is running. Turn a setting off to restore the captured value. Some changes take effect when the game reads the table again.
strings.page.enable_gauges: Enable custom Beta, Burst and Tachy capacity
strings.page.disable_all: Disable all and restore captured values
strings.page.searching: Looking for the player data table...
strings.page.ready: Ready. No runtime changes are active.
strings.page.applied: Updated %d field(s); %d could not be changed.
strings.page.restored: Restored %d field(s); %d changed elsewhere and were left untouched.
strings.page.ambiguous: Found more than one player data table. No new changes were applied.
strings.page.error: Could not initialize the game reflection API. See CPS.log.
strings.page.save_error: Could not save the plugin settings. See CPS.log.
